visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing glasses and a light grey suit stands in a brightly lit, modern cafe. He holds a folded blue Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 close to his face, smiling directly at the camera. Behind him, patrons sit at minimalist wooden tables, and soft indoor light filters through large windows. (2) The camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the phone's hinge and side profile, highlighting its thin design. The man then performs a smooth motion, sliding the folded device effortlessly into the inner pocket of his suit jacket to showcase its extreme portability and sleek form factor. (3) A split-screen comparison appears showing the Z Fold 6 on the left and the Z Fold 7 on the right, with the latter appearing significantly thinner. The man unfolds the device to reveal a large, bezel-less internal display, while variety-style text overlays provide details on weight and millimeter thickness. (4) Seated in a professional office, the man holds the unfolded phone, demonstrating multi-window multitasking with applications like Solitaire, a calendar, and a web browser. Screen recordings detail the Snapdragon processor specs and the high-efficiency AI processing power of the device in a clean digital interface. (5) The man is seen in a cafe again, using the phone in 'Flex mode' where it is partially folded and propped on a table next to a cup of coffee and a dessert. He uses the camera's hands-free capability to capture photos of himself, highlighting the device's utility as its own stand. (6) A demonstration of a video meeting is shown on the screen, featuring a split-screen view with real-time AI translation subtitles appearing at the bottom. The man is seen taking notes on the other half of the screen, emphasizing the device's role as a productivity tool for international business. (7) Transitioning to a recording app demo, the screen shows a waveform of a voice note being processed. The interface highlights an 'Audio Eraser' feature that removes background noise. The man gestures toward the phone in a noisy cafe environment to explain how the AI isolates his voice from the surroundings. (8) A sequence of night photography showcases the device's camera performance, featuring high-contrast shots of the Taipei 101 skyscraper and urban cityscapes at night. The man uses his fingers to zoom in on high-resolution details of a building, illustrating the 200-megapixel sensor's clarity and low-light capabilities. (9) Finally, the man returns to his office setting, folding the phone and putting it away while smiling confidently. A large yellow and black graphic logo for 'Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7' appears on screen, concluding the promotional showcase with a focus on premium design and high intelligence.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator with a high-arousal, energetic pitch begins a technical review of the Z Fold 7. An upbeat, electronic pop BGM with a steady 128 BPM pulse supports the vocal track. A quick digital 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to design specs. (2) The narrator's speech rate increases while describing the device's thinness and lightweight profile. The BGM maintains a consistent four-on-the-floor beat strength, while technical UI 'click' sounds emphasize on-screen graphic changes. (3) A distinct acoustic shift occurs during the cafe scene; the BGM volume ducks slightly to reveal a field-recorded ambient floor of muted cafe chatter and light background music. A notification 'ding' sound triggers a demonstration of the AI assistant features. (4) The audio texture changes as the narrator enters the 'demonstration phase.' The sound of a digital recording being played back is heard, followed by the activation of an 'Audio Eraser' effect which audibly suppresses the low-frequency cafe hum. (5) In the final phase, the BGM swells in volume with brighter spectral characteristics as the narrator concludes with a confident, authoritative tone. A crisp stinger SFX coincides with the appearance of the Samsung brand logo, ending the track with high tonal clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 7 by emphasizing its revolutionary thin design and high-efficiency AI features like real-time translation and noise reduction to attract professional and tech-savvy users.
